title: Customer Service Policies
content: CUSTOMER SERVICE POLICIES Refund Policy Customers may request a refund within 30 days of purchase. A valid order number is required to process the refund. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method. Cancellation Policy Customers may cancel an order before it has been shipped. Once an order has been shipped, cancellation may not be available and the customer should follow the return procedure. Return Policy Eligible products can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Products should be returned in their original condition. Certain personalized or final-sale products may not be eligible for return. Customer Support Customer support is available Monday through Saturday. Customers can contact support for order questions, refunds, returns, account issues, and product-related assistance. Complaint

Complaint Handling Customer complaints should include the order number and a clear description of the problem. Complaints are reviewed by the customer support team and may be escalated when additional investigation is required. Account Security Customers should never share passwords or verification codes with another person. If suspicious activity is detected, the customer should change their password and contact customer support.

title: Product Information
content: PRODUCT INFORMATION Standard Plan The Standard Plan provides access to basic customer support and standard service features. Premium Plan The Premium Plan includes priority customer support and access to premium service features. Premium customers receive priority assistance when contacting customer support. Delivery Standard orders are normally processed using standard delivery. Premium orders are eligible for priority processing and may be delivered within two business days when priority delivery is available. Product Support Customers experiencing a problem with a product should provide the product name, order number, and a description of the issue. Warranty Warranty eligibility depends on the product and purchase conditions. Customers should provide their order details when requesting warranty support.
